deviations.what: The anti-join that finds new classes matches on (year, cls) only, against base classes pooled across all firms, so a firm's forward class is wrongly not counted as new whenever any other firm has that class in its base for the same focal year.

notes: Everything else matches the spec: filing-year dating, first-listed filter, dropping missing classes, base window t-5..t-1 and forward window t+1..t+3 with year t excluded, NA for an empty base, 0 when the base exists but there are no forward patents, de-duplicated firm_year output, and the five columns. The fix is to anti-join on .(firm_id, year, cls) against unique(base).
